name: Camera Tiles
description: The camera feed as a grid of soft tiles that rise where something moves, with a drifting pattern until the camera is turned on.

props.name: cols
props.description: Number of columns. Tiles are square, so the rows follow the aspect ratio of the element.

props.name: mode
props.description: `water` maps brightness onto a ramp from ink through water blue to snow, `color` keeps the sampled colour, `mono` runs from ink to snow.

props.name: mirror
props.description: Flip the feed horizontally, like a mirror.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between tiles as a fraction of a cell.

props.name: maxElevation
props.description: How far a tile rises where something moves, in pixels. Raised tiles also grow slightly and cast a blue shadow.

props.name: motionSensitivity
props.description: From 0 to 1. Higher values raise tiles for smaller changes between frames.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: From 0 to 1. Higher values settle raised tiles more slowly and steady the brightness between frames.

props.name: autoStart
props.description: Ask for the camera on mount. Leave it off so the camera only starts when the user presses the button.

props.name: onReady
props.description: Called once the camera is streaming.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the camera is denied, missing or fails to start. The pattern keeps running and a short message is shown.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the grid. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the grid. The camera button sits at the bottom centre.
